# Orch Clarify

Chair only; workers use `ask`. Read the code first; never ask what the repo answers.
Ask only what changes the work: scope edge, acceptance, constraints, taste owner, priority, contact, rollback, branch.
Ledger top: `## Clarified`, `- Q: … -> …`, `- Branch: …`, then `- [ ] N. <req>`. No `Assumption:`.
`orch ledger check` must pass or spawn denies. No questions mid-work after go.
